definitions.explanation: The upper limb of the body from shoulder to hand.
One's ability or skill at something, especially a craft or profession.

notes:
{腕|うで} has two main meanings: the physical arm (from shoulder to hand) and skill or ability.

SENSE 1 — ARM:
Refers to the entire arm. Common compounds:
- {腕|うで}⟦{時計|どけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧: wristwatch
- {腕|うで}⟦{組|ぐ}み→組：02668_kumi⟧: folding one's arms
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{腕|うで}: right arm (also figurative: "right-hand man")

SENSE 2 — SKILL:
Commonly used to describe one's ability at a craft or profession:
- {腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be skilled
- {腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to be highly skilled
- {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish one's skills
- {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to improve one's skills
- {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to show off one's skills

The skill sense is especially common for cooking, craftsmanship, and professional work.
